description: This file defines factory functions to create various select list components used in a user interface, such as standard, searchable, filterable, and settings lists. It imports types and components from external and internal modules, and exports functions to instantiate these UI elements with specified parameters.

methods.name: export function createSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSelectList
methods.description: Creates a new SelectList with provided items and maximum visible items, using the theme for select lists.

methods.name: export function createSearchableSelectList(items: SelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createSearchableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a SearchableSelectList with provided items, maximum visible items, and theme for searchable lists.

methods.name: export function createFilterableSelectList(items: FilterableSelectItem[], maxVisible = 7) { createFilterableSelectList
methods.description: Creates a FilterableSelectList with provided filterable items, maximum visible items, and theme.

methods.name: export function createSettingsList( createSettingsList
methods.description: Creates a SettingsList with provided setting items, maximum visible items, theme, and callbacks for change and cancel actions.
